yaml:
name: ghalint
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

jobs:
  ghalint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

          curl -L https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint/releases/download/v1.5.1/ghalint_1.5.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
